overview_description.description: Qoyod.com is a web-based accounting solution that targets KSA based-SMEs. Users can seamlessly issue invoices and manage expenses/budgets while automatically recording corresponding journal entries (i.e., Qoyod/قيود in Arabic). Users are also able to populate their financial statements and business reports for both commercial and statutory requirements within KSA.

product.name: Qoyod Accounting Software
product.description: A cloud-based accounting software designed to manage financial and accounting operations for small and medium businesses.

product.name: Qoyod Point of Sale (POS) Application
product.description: A mobile and web application to streamline sales and purchase transactions and accelerate payment processing.

product.name: Qoyod Collection Service
product.description: A service that enables businesses to securely and accurately collect invoice payments, reducing human errors.

product.name: Qoyod Lend Service
product.description: A financing service connecting entrepreneurs with various funding sources to support business growth and expansion.

product.name: Professional Accounting Services
product.description: Comprehensive accounting services including company formation, bookkeeping, and tax filing to complement the Qoyod accounting software.

product.name: Qoyod Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to enter accounting entries, add invoices, and manage integrations directly from their smartphones.
